name: GuestPass
description: Send someone a temporary link to one movie, episode, season or series. They watch it without an account and without seeing the rest of your library. Injects its client script in memory, so it works on containers with a read-only or root-owned web root.
overview: Expiring guest links for Jellyfin, no account needed.

versions.changelog: First GuestPass release. Fork of Franciskid/jellyfin-plugin-sharelinks with the on-disk index.html rewrite replaced by in-memory IStartupFilter injection, so the plugin works on containers whose web root is not writable. Adds an injection status panel, a switch to disable injection without uninstalling, and context-menu matching for non-English web clients including Dutch and German.
